chapters.chapter_title: Infrastructure Security in the Real World

questions.question: What is a primary objective of physical infrastructure security in cybersecurity?
options: A. Protecting physical assets, facilities, and personnel from physical threats and unauthorized access.
B. Speeding up network routing tables.
C. Standardizing software source code formatting.
questions.answer: A. Protecting physical assets, facilities, and personnel from physical threats and unauthorized access.

questions.question: Which security concept uses multiple layered security controls to protect critical infrastructure?
Which authentication factor classification does a fingerprint scan fall under?
Which type of device is commonly used to control physical access at security perimeters such as doorways or gates?
options: A. Smart card reader and electronic lock
questions.answer: A. Smart card reader and electronic lock

questions.question: Which type of video camera allows operators to remotely adjust its view angle, direction, and magnification?
Which system is primarily used to capture, process, and store video footage from IP-based surveillance cameras?
What is the core function of an Intrusion Detection System (IDS)?
options: A. To encrypt all stored files on a hard drive.
B. To monitor network or system traffic for unauthorized activity and alert administrators.
C. To physical block access through building doors.
D. To assign IP addresses automatically to host devices.
questions.answer: B. To monitor network or system traffic for unauthorized activity and alert administrators.

questions.question: What term describes a scenario where an IDS incorrectly flags harmless normal activity as a security violation?

chapters.chapter_title: Local Host Security in the Real World

questions.question: Which process involves disabling unused operating system services, closing unneeded ports, and configuring security settings to protect a single computer?
What is a critical practice for protecting local operating systems against newly identified vulnerabilities?
options: B. Regularly applying security patches and software updates
C. Keeping default administrator account credentials
D. Turning off local host firewalls
questions.answer: B. Regularly applying security patches and software updates
